name: proofpress
description: Govern evidence-backed agent knowledge with bounded proposals and Human Approval.

interface.shortDescription: Govern what agent-produced knowledge may be reused.
interface.longDescription: Proofpress provides a governed-context workflow for evidence submission, bounded claim proposals, and approved-context retrieval. Connect it to the Hosted or self-hosted workspace assigned to your team. Human Approval remains outside the agent tool surface.
defaultPrompt: Initialize a Proofpress policy for this repository.
Retrieve eligible Proofpress governed context for this task.
Prepare a bounded evidence-backed claim proposal in Proofpress.
